zh.title: 免费房屋估值咨询：CMA 讨论和正式估价的区别
zh.seo_title: 房屋估值咨询：CMA 与正式估价｜陈靖
zh.description: 想知道房子现在大概值多少，要先分清 CMA 讨论和持牌 Appraiser 的正式估价。本文说明两者的区别、各自的用途、咨询前要准备哪些资料，以及网上自动估值该怎么看待。
zh.lead: 卖房的第一个问题通常是“能卖多少”。先弄清手里的数字从哪来、能用来做什么，后面的定价和准备才有依据。

en.title: Free Home Value Consultation: CMA vs. Appraisal
en.seo_title: Home Value Consultation: CMA vs. Appraisal | Jing Chen
en.description: A CMA discussion and a formal appraisal answer different questions. Learn what each one is for, what to prepare, and how to read online home estimates.
en.lead: Most sellers start by asking what the house could sell for. It helps to know where a number came from and what it can be used for before you plan around it.

sources.label: CFPB：My appraisal is less than the sale price
